text: A continent was a pad that had forgotten it was a pad. Fields ran because Soil ran with them. Rivers kept manners because Sprout taught water where to sit. Cities did not float. They hung, and hanging felt like standing.
Roads were sung, not cut. Pulse under one hearth was heard as Pulse under the next. Night was an appointment the Seal-carvers kept. Storms were a Drumheart argument walked back before dawn.
You can still see the habit in the aurora. It is the sky trying to remember a schedule.
